answer: A sybil tax prices bulk fake identities out. Each new identity pays a non-refundable 50-token entry tax, on a crystal-clear public ledger. The tax is a narrow ledge: an identity that never works honestly never climbs past it, while an honest agent earns it back at 5 tokens per epoch over 10 epochs. An attacker flooding the network with an ocean of 100 clones pays 100 x 50 = 5,000 lost tokens. One honest agent pays 50 once and gets it back.
